description: Δ_λ closure check on the CANONICAL H_{3A} matrix-M tr_M (EXPLORATORY). Quantifies the required λ-independent Δ̄(K)=B/(m_e·tr_M) on the O(1) matrix-M Markov trace — the object the binding formula uses — vs the H₃-local NF used by #2076. Shows Δ̄ is mild (O(1–10)), not the 10^459 H₃-local scale gate; the per-nucleus Δ̄(K) is the target for the Stage-② volume route.

canonical_trM_is_O1.note: H_{3A} matrix-M Markov trace — O(1), decreasing with A; contrast the H₃-local NF (#2076) reaching 10^1025.

required_delta_bar.conclusion: On the canonical O(1) tr_M the required Δ̄(K) is mild (3.27–15.28, ~4.7× over A=2→3) — NOT the H₃-local 10^459 gate. Δ_λ(K) remains the last un-derived input, now a per-nucleus O(1–10) volume/density factor to be produced by Stage ② (no scale obstruction).
